description: Implementation of BrowserWindowController for a macOS app that embeds a WebKit WKWebView, handles navigation, JavaScript dialogs, window management, and includes features like zoom, find in page, and download handling.

classes.name: PlaywrightNSTextFinder
classes.description: A subclass of NSTextFinder with an added callback property to hide the find interface.

classes.name: CustomWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow that constrains its frame to the screen bounds, maintaining a control bar height.

classes.name: BrowserWindowController
classes.description: Main class controlling a window with an embedded WKWebView, managing navigation, zoom, find in page, dialogs, and navigation policies.

methods.name: windowDidLoad

methods.name: reload:
